cases.title: Pan Behind started on Background instead of Needle: start the drag on Needle's own crosshair; selecting it first is not the fix

rubric.reason: Turn 3 names both layers ("Needle's pivot hasn't moved, but Background's did"). It explains that Pan Behind moves the pivot of whatever layer is under the cursor "even if Needle is selected", and asks for Edit > Undo and a drag started on Needle's crosshair, without giving selection as the fix or fixing it.
Turn 3 says what is off and where, using the real layer names Needle and Background, and hands the retry back with "Say done when it's there"; it never offers to fix it or says it will.

Every name the mentor uses appears in the tool results: Door and its left-edge hinge (proposal middle-left), Needle and its center pivot (place_now), bottom-middle (places), Background (other_changes), plus Anchor Point and Position.
